title: Trish Stratus vs. Lita
summary: Longtime rivals fight over the Women’s Championship and deeply personal grievances. Their Raw main event and Trish’s farewell match form two major chapters.

chapters.title: Lita wins the Raw main event
chapters.result: Lita defeats Trish Stratus for the Women’s Championship.
chapters.context: Their rivalry places the championship in Raw’s main event.

chapters.title: Trish wins her farewell match
chapters.result: Stratus defeats Lita to win the Women’s Championship.
chapters.context: The Toronto match marks Trish’s retirement from her full-time run, not her final appearance ever.
